# Citation audit — consolidated ledger

This file exists so the run report reads a single complete ledger. **It is an
index, not an audit.** The evidence lives in the two round reports:

- [`citation-audit-round1.md`](citation-audit-round1.md) — citations [1]-[70],
  graded before the observability dimension was added.
- [`citation-audit-round2.md`](citation-audit-round2.md) — citations [71]-[92]
  in full, plus re-verification of [5], [30], [49], [50] and [58], whose
  citation-entry text changed after round 1.

Where a citation was graded in both rounds, **the round-2 grade is the one
listed below**, because it was issued against the current text.

The matching consistency reviews are
[`consistency-review-round1.md`](consistency-review-round1.md) and
[`consistency-review-round2.md`](consistency-review-round2.md). All nine issues
across both rounds are marked RESOLVED.

## Two PARTIAL grades, and what happened to them

Round 2 issued two PARTIAL grades. Both were caused by defects in the
deliverable that have since been corrected. **The grades are left as issued
rather than silently upgraded**, because they were accurate against the text the
auditor actually read.

- **[73] PARTIAL** — a quote about pre-v2.1.214 usage inflation was attributed
  to [73] when the sentence appears on [71]. Reattributed to [71].
- **[75] PARTIAL** — the deliverable's prose said "18" undocumented Codex metric
  names while its own enumerated list contained 20. Both round-2 auditors caught
  this independently, by counting rather than by trusting the prose. Corrected
  to 20 in all five places it appeared.
